boundaries: Physical views have no signature, trust or modification authority.
Exact ByteRange endpoints must be selected and authenticated separately; EOF whitespace is never normalized.
Only the validated initial linearized pair may use forward Prev; unindexed syntax and arbitrary forward chains remain unsupported by history inspection.
Objects after primary xref streams are accepted only with verified indexed nonoverlapping extents.
Encrypted raw object-stream contents are not authenticated or decrypted by physical inspection.
Linearization hints and optimized delivery are not interpreted or certified. The initial L must identify its exact physical EOF interval.

oracle.trust: Offline; no trust roots, no modification authorization claim.
oracle.linearizedMapping: Two initial xref sections counted by pyHanko correspond to one complete physical revision.
